She strode with her sisters down a long , dark hallway , seemingly alone , weapons clutched in their hands , too .

If the bad guy truly had been watching from the shadows , waiting to strike , he probably would have seen them moving in slow motion , their hair blowing in the breeze .
Also , scary music would have been playing in the background .
Too bad this was n't hollywood .
Taliyah was in the middle .
She was the oldest among them by far , as well as the strongest , the deadliest .
Tall , slender , pale from head to toe , she looked like an elegant ice queen-and had a personality to match .
Emotions were not something Taliyah allowed herself to experience .
While Kaia had always striven to be like their mother , Taliyah had opted to be the opposite .
Logical , level-headed , a planner .
Bianka and Kaia flanked her sides , with gwen on Kaia 's left .
At one end of the estrogen brigade was Sabin , at the other was Lysander .
Typically at events such as these , consorts were supposed to trail a few feet behind , but these men were hardly archetypal .
They were equals .
Beloved .
Determined to protect .
Each of the women radiated a white-hot tension that blended perfectly with Kaia 's own .
All thanks to the very stupid Strider .
He was n't going to support her .
Earlier today gwen had led her to believe ... Had made her think ... Hope ... Crave ... Oh , well .

Stupid , stupid Strider .
Doomed , doomed Kaia .

He was rejection , humiliation and heartbreak wrapped in a pretty package .
She could find another pretty package without all the extras , thank you .

Sadly , she had a feeling there were going to be a lot of starring roles .

Thump .

Thump .

In `` Brew city , '' wisconsin .

Really ?

Girl had developed a new ability , apparently , but when questioned , had refused to give up the deets .
Like what the ever-loving hell could she do ?

Pouter !

Right ? ''

Through anything , everything .

Innumerable .

Juliette 's family .

Odd .

Tabitha the vicious .

For good .

Pride .
Why ?

For her .

To Strider .

Here , with her .

I will not cry .

Red .
